notes: 6MP IR Fisheye WizMind, circular image sensor (pixelWidth = pixelHeight = 2560, native square fisheye frame). Datasheet p.2 'Field of View: 1.68 mm: H: 185deg; V: 185deg; D: 185deg'. HFOV >= 180deg -> use arc/fisheye geometry model per phase-03, not the rectilinear cone. Max illumination distance 15 m (IR), lower than other models - small built-in IR array typical of fisheye form factor.
